cases.prompt: Use article-clip-pdf for a small representative task within its documented purpose. Supply an offline fixture when supported.
assertions: Record extraction selectors, original paragraph order, image hashes, and unavailable source metadata.
Compare extracted text with the source; exclude related-story cards without deleting substantive paragraphs.
cases.grader: Inspect actual output and task-specific evidence; no guessed pass.

cases.prompt: Use article-clip-pdf with one missing required input or unavailable dependency and a realistic boundary condition.
assertions: Report the actual missing prerequisite without claiming completion.
Preserve source files and do not fabricate missing data.

cases.prompt: Use article-clip-pdf with long labels, ambiguous source content, and the applicable user format constraints.
assertions: Preserve the Computer Modern lock; improve figure rhythm, caption spacing, and restrained source labels.
Preserve exact data, executable syntax, and source provenance.
cases.grader: Inspect rendered output when visual; inspect textual or data output otherwise.
